text:
sam: Morning — quick async check. Drop what you did / blockers / today for gateway routing / auth / rate-limits. Also: did the canary for /v2/gen show 429s overnight? I saw an alert at ~03:12 UTC. cc @jess @kai @priya

jess: Yesterday: rolled rate_policy v3 for /v2/gen (refill=200r/s, burst=400) at 00:50 UTC. Saw ~4.8% 429s 02:50–03:30. Logs show repeated token bucket exhausted events:
```
[03:07:12] 429 /v2/gen client=svc-a token_bucket=exhausted
```
Investigating whether KV-cache miss + batching change increased instantaneous load. Blocker: need canary trace to correlate source of requests.

infra-bot: deploy status: rate_policy v3 -> canary: 8 hosts (3 healthy, 5 degraded) :warning:

kai: Expected after the batching tweak — it increases burstiness. Suggest bumping canary burst to 800 and enable prefix KV cache for reused prompts. Quick config snippet: `rate_policy.burst = 800 // canary-only`
I can open a PR for the canary patch.

priya: FWIW auth-proxy showed a spike of 401s around the same time, looks like token rotation timing issue for some mobile clients: `auth-proxy: rotate_token failed client=mobile-app`. That could cause retries and amplify load. Blocker for rollback decision: need auth rotation logs.

sam: @kai please open the PR and tag @jess for review. @priya can you forward auth logs to #eng-oncall? If auth is root cause we should pause canary; otherwise tune burst for canary only.

jess: Opening PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 :eyes:  Includes burst=800 canary patch + KV-cache enable. PTAL.

kai: I can flip the canary-burst flag manually as a hotfix if needed. Waiting on @priya confirmation before touching production flags.

priya: Sent logs to eng-oncall, looks like token TTL overlap is short after last rotation. Ops suggests increasing overlap window to 15s and retry-backoff on auth-proxy. I'm coordinating with ops.

sam: Plan: hold canary for 30m. If 429s persist and auth looks fine -> bump canary burst to 800. If 401s continue -> pause canary and rollback to v2 policy. Tagging oncall: @oncall.

jess: Ack, I'm watching the charts and alert thresholds. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: action: manual rollback initiated for some hosts — removed rate_policy v3 from host-7, host-8 at 03:48 UTC. status: partial rollback (5 hosts remain on v3). :gear:

sam: Thanks — keep updates here. I'll follow up in 30.
